sources.title: 3 Tonne Low Profile Garage Jack
sources.markdown:
# 3 Tonne Low Profile Garage Jack

Capacity 3 tonne. Min height 80mm. Max height 505mm. Dual pump. Carrying handle. Rubber saddle.

Includes carry case. CE marked.

sources.title: Low Profile Trolley Jack 3T
sources.markdown:
# Low Profile Trolley Jack 3T

3 tonne capacity. Lift range 85-520mm. Steel construction. Swivel castors. Overload protection valve.
